classification.difficultyReason: Apply the taught rounding rule independently at each specified precision, retaining trailing zeros and handling carries such as 9.9899 becoming 10.0. The completed example scaffolds the table; repeated entries add no new demand.

inlines.text: Inspect the critical digit immediately after each required decimal place. Round each column directly from the original number, adding trailing zeros to show the requested precision.
For 9.9899, rounding to 1 d.p. carries into the tens to give 10.0; rounding to 3 d.p. carries into the hundredths to give 9.990.
